name: Download Instrument Logs from Google Sheets
notes: Downloads instrument log sheets from Google Sheets (QEX2, QEX3, LUM1, LUM2, ECL1) and saves as CSV and XLSX to Y:\temporary_files\JO\keep\instrumentlogs. Appends to existing files and deduplicates rows. Requires internet access, Python with packages: requests, pandas, openpyxl. If python.exe is not on PATH, provide the full path (e.g. C:\Python312\python.exe or use a venv).
